title: 面向QMSum的高效查询聚焦会议摘要的检索跨度训练
summary: 针对QMSum缺乏评分器的问题，在统一实现下重新评估15个系统。406M Fusion-in-Decoder专家模型从长输入切换到2000词检索跨度时ROUGE-1下降6.30，跨度微调可恢复损失，测试得分36.33，与1.2B系统无统计显著差异，但参数量约为三分之一，峰值推理内存不到一半。
summary_en: QMSum lacks a scorer, making query-focused meeting summarization hard to compare. Rescoring 15 systems under one implementation, a 406M Fusion-in-Decoder specialist loses 6.30 ROUGE-1 moving from capped long input to 2,000-word retrieved spans; span-regime fine-tuning recovers it, scoring 36.33 ROUGE-1 versus 35.41 for a 1.2B system, a statistically insignificant difference, with about one-third the parameters and less than half the peak inference memory.
